        put(s1, n - 1, ones);

    private static boolean canPut(char[] s, int p, char d) {

    }

        } else {
            s[p] = d;
        }
    }

    private static int possible(char[] s) {
        if (s[0] == '0') return 0;
        int p = 1;
        if (s[0] == '_') p *= 9;
        for (int i = 1; i < s.length; i++) if (s[i] == '_') p *= 10;
